models.name: Qwen3.5 9B
models.notes: Strongest model under 10B. Hybrid Gated DeltaNet design keeps the KV cache small. Native image and video input. Thinking is on by default. The 9.65B total includes the vision encoder (mmproj adds 0.92GB).

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.notes: Best 4B-class model and a good default for laptops. Hybrid thinking, native vision.

models.name: Qwen3.5 2B
models.notes: Phone-class multimodal model with hybrid thinking. Linear attention keeps long-context memory low.

models.name: Qwen3.5 0.8B
models.notes: Tiny multimodal model for phones and browsers. Fine for simple tasks, weak on knowledge.

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.notes: Takes text, image and audio input. 4.5B effective params, 8B with per-layer embeddings. Strong generalist for 8-16GB machines. The Ollama download is much larger than the GGUF because it bundles the vision and audio towers. mmproj adds 0.99GB.

models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.notes: 2.3B effective params, with audio and vision input. Built for phones. The Ollama download is larger than the GGUF because of the bundled towers.

models.name: MiniCPM5 2B
models.notes: Released Sept 2026 and trending (about 850K downloads). Dense model with hybrid thinking. Claims to be SOTA in the 2B class.

models.name: Granite 4.2 8B
models.notes: Native thinking with full, off and low-effort modes. Strong tool calling and RAG. Supersedes Granite 4.1.

models.name: Granite 4.2 3B
models.notes: Compact enterprise reasoning and tool-calling model with switchable thinking.

models.name: Ornith 1.5 9B
models.notes: Agentic coding model built on Qwen3.5-9B, with image input. Popular for local coding agents. Thinking is on by default.

models.name: Ling 3.0 Tiny (7.9B-A1.3B)
models.notes: MoE (128 experts, 8+1 active) with 3:1 KDA+MLA hybrid attention. Decodes fast on CPU and Mac: 86-90 tok/s on an M4 Pro at FP8. Thinking is on by default. Official GGUF works in llama.cpp and LM Studio.

models.name: LFM2.5 2.6B
models.notes: Hybrid conv+attention and very fast on CPU. Good for agents, tools and RAG. Not recommended for coding.

models.name: Nanbeige4.2 3B
models.notes: Looped transformer with 3B non-embedding params that reuses layers, so it decodes slower than its size suggests. Strong agentic scores. GGUFs available from bartowski.

models.name: LFM2.5 8B-A1B
models.notes: On-device MoE with 1.5B active params. 24 layers (18 conv + 6 GQA) keep the KV cache tiny. Reasoning-tuned and built for tool calling. The card says 8.3B; safetensors metadata reports 8.47B.

models.name: Ternary Bonsai 8B (1.58-bit)
models.notes: Ternary QAT of Qwen3-8B. The native Q2_0 file is 2.18GB, listed in q4_gb because no Q4/Q8 builds exist. Needs PrismML's llama.cpp fork (CPU and Metal) and is not in Ollama yet. Lets 8B-class quality fit on 4GB devices.

models.name: MiniCPM5 1B
models.notes: 1B model with hybrid think/no-think. Strong for its size.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B
models.notes: Mamba-2 hybrid with few attention layers. Reasoning can be toggled. Aimed at edge agents, with about 4.9M downloads.

models.name: LFM2.5 350M
models.notes: Ultra-small model for extraction and classification. Runs almost anywhere, including the browser.

models.name: LFM2.5 1.2B (Instruct / Thinking)
models.notes: Runs in under 1GB and is fast on phone CPUs. Instruct is available via hf.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct-GGUF.

models.name: Ministral 3 8B
models.notes: 8.4B LM plus 0.4B vision encoder, with image input. Comes in Instruct, Reasoning and Base variants. Native function calling.

models.name: Ministral 3 3B
models.notes: Edge model with vision input. A Reasoning variant is also available, including in WebLLM.

models.name: OLMo 3 7B (Instruct / Think)
models.notes: Fully open: data, code and checkpoints. Think variant is olmo-3:7b-think. Full MHA gives a large KV cache (~2GB at 4K context).

models.name: Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct
models.notes: Popular small VLM for OCR, GUI and video. Vision projector adds ~1.2GB. Qwen3.5-9B largely supersedes it.

models.name: Qwen3-VL 4B Instruct
models.notes: Compact VLM for OCR and screenshots. A 2B sibling exists (qwen3-vl:2b).

models.name: Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507
models.in_browser: transformers.js ONNX (onnx-community/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-ONNX); WebLLM only has the original Qwen3-4B-q4f16_1-MLC
models.notes: Non-thinking update of Qwen3 4B with 256K context. Still very popular.

models.name: Qwen3 4B Thinking 2507
models.notes: Reasoning-only 4B, strong at math and code. Long chains of thought make it slow on weak hardware.

models.name: Gemma 3 270M
models.notes: Tiny base for task-specific fine-tuning. Not a capable general chat model.

models.name: SmolLM3 3B
models.notes: Fully open recipe, dual-mode reasoning. Context extends to 128K with YaRN.

models.name: Gemma 3n E4B
models.notes: Superseded by Gemma 4 E4B. Mobile-first MatFormer with audio and vision input. Ollama download is 7.5GB.

models.name: Gemma 3n E2B
models.notes: Superseded by Gemma 4 E2B. Phone-first model.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B
models.notes: R1-0528 chain of thought distilled into Qwen3-8B. It is the default deepseek-r1:8b tag in Ollama. Very verbose.

models.name: Phi-4-mini-reasoning 3.8B
models.notes: Math-focused reasoning model, not meant for general chat.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.notes: Hybrid thinking with a huge fine-tune ecosystem. Largely superseded by Qwen3.5-9B. Context reaches 128K with YaRN.

models.name: Qwen3 1.7B
models.notes: Small hybrid-thinking model, common on phones and in browsers.

models.name: Qwen3 0.6B
models.notes: Extremely widely downloaded tiny LLM. Browser-friendly but limited quality.

models.name: Gemma 3 4B
models.notes: Image input and 140+ languages. Ollama download is 3.3GB. Superseded by Gemma 4 E4B but still popular.

models.name: Gemma 3 1B
models.notes: Text-only and popular for phones and browsers.

models.name: Phi-4-mini-instruct 3.8B
models.notes: Good logic and math for its size, with function calling. Weak on world knowledge.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 7B
models.notes: Original R1 distill, good at math and code reasoning and poor at chat. Superseded by the 0528-Qwen3-8B distill.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama 8B
models.notes: R1 reasoning distilled into Llama 3.1 8B.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B
models.notes: Tiny reasoning model, decent at math and weak elsewhere.

models.name: SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct
models.notes: Older small model still common in browser demos. Full MHA and 8K context.

models.name: SmolLM2 360M Instruct
models.notes: Runs on nearly anything. Only useful for very simple tasks.

models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B Instruct
models.notes: Classic small local coder for chat and fill-in-the-middle. For agentic coding, Ornith 1.5 9B and Qwen3.5-9B are now stronger.

models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B Instruct
models.notes: Popular tab-autocomplete (FIM) model for Continue and Tabby.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.notes: Ubiquitous default small model, now outclassed by newer 3-4B models. Meta has released no newer small model.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
models.notes: Very popular phone and browser model (about 7.5M downloads). Basic quality.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
models.notes: Classic 8B baseline, still ubiquitous and still trending on HF. Meta's only newer open model is Muse Glimmer 30B (Aug 2026), which belongs in the next tier.

models.name: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3
models.notes: Legacy but still widely pulled. Superseded by Ministral 3 8B.

changelog: Verified: all 15 of the newest/least-known models exist on HF with matching params and creation dates (MiniCPM5-2B 2026-09-06, 2.52B; MiniCPM5-1B 2026-05; Granite 4.2 8B/3B 2026-08-07, 8.79B/3.66B; Ornith-1.5-9B 2026-08-18, 9.65B, MIT; Ling-3.0-tiny 2026-08-10, 7.89B; LFM2.5-2.6B 2026-07-28; Nanbeige4.2-3B 2026-07-21, 4.17B; LFM2.5-8B-A1B 2026-05-28; Nemotron-3-Nano-4B 2026-03; LFM2.5-350M; Qwen3.5-9B; Gemma 4 E2B/E4B; Ministral-3-8B). Evidence: https://huggingface.co/api/models/<repo>

Verified: GGUF sizes match exactly for Qwen3.5-9B (5.68/9.53/17.92), Qwen3.5-4B Q4 2.74, Gemma 4 E4B (4.98/8.19/15.05), Gemma 4 E2B (3.11/5.05/9.31), MiniCPM5-2B (1.56/2.68/5.04), MiniCPM5-1B Q4 0.69, LFM2.5-8B-A1B (5.16/9.01/16.95), LFM2.5-2.6B (1.67/2.87/5.4), Granite 4.2 8B (5.35/9.35/17.59), Ornith 1.5 9B (5.78/9.79/18.41), Nanbeige4.2 (2.68/4.43/8.34), Nemotron 3 Nano 4B Q4 2.9. Evidence: https://huggingface.co/api/models/unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF/tree/main and the equivalent trees

Changed: Ling 3.0 Tiny q4_gb 4.92 -> 4.82 to use the official inclusionAI GGUF (bartowski's is 4.92), and min mem 5.4 -> 5.3. Confirmed 7.9B total / 1.3B active and 128 experts with 8+1 active. https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny-GGUF

Confirmed: LFM2.5-8B-A1B is 8.3B total / 1.5B active with 24 layers (18 conv + 6 GQA). The HF safetensors metadata reports 8.47B; kept the card value and noted the gap. https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B
Confirmed: Gemma 4 small models have 128K context (the card says 256K only for the medium models). https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-E4B-it

Confirmed: Nanbeige4.2-3B has 256K context, 4B total / 3B non-embedding params and a looped transformer. Replaced the unverified claim that it needs Nanbeige's llama.cpp fork with a note that bartowski and owao GGUFs exist. https://huggingface.co/Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.2-3B
Confirmed: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B was released 2026-08-10 (Apache 2.0) and meta-llama has no new small model. https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/10/meta-muse-glimmer-open-weight-ai.html

Verified: all Ollama tags exist, including qwen3.5:{0.8b,2b,4b,9b}, gemma4:{e2b,e4b}, granite4.2:{3b,8b}, ornith-1.5:9b, lfm2.5:8b, lfm2.5-thinking:1.2b, nemotron-3-nano:4b, ministral-3:{3b,8b}, olmo-3:7b-instruct, qwen3-vl:{4b,8b}, deepseek-r1:8b-llama-distill-q4_K_M and qwen3:4b-{instruct,thinking}-2507-q4_K_M. https://ollama.com/library/<name>/tags

Verified: every WebLLM ID in the draft exists in the mlc-ai/web-llm config.ts, including Qwen3.5-9B (6433MB), Qwen3.5-4B (3868MB) and Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512-BF16. Added the WebLLM ID for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B-q4f16_1-MLC. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlc-ai/web-llm/main/src/config.ts
Verified: all 27 cited onnx-community / LiquidAI / mistralai ONNX repos exist (HTTP 200 from the HF API).

Added: Ternary Bonsai 8B (Prism ML, 2026-04). 1.58-bit QAT of Qwen3-8B, 2.18GB Q2_0 GGUF, 64K context, Apache-2.0, needs the PrismML llama.cpp fork, ~370K downloads. https://huggingface.co/prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-8B-gguf

Removed: unverifiable benchmark claims from notes (AA Index scores, '113 tok/s on a Ryzen', '253 tok/s on M5 Max', 'tops AA phone leaderboard', 'about 5M GGUF downloads' for Ornith, 'no Phi-5' assertions); kept only facts confirmed on model cards.
Changed: softened Qwen2.5-Coder 7B note, removing 'There is no Qwen3-Coder under 30B' as the reason. Ornith 1.5 9B, a Qwen3.5-based coder, now exists in this tier.
Changed: Granite 4.2 3B confidence high -> medium because its GGUF sizes could not be fetched (the unsloth repo returned auth errors). They are consistent with the 3.66B params by formula.
notes:
Every entry in the draft is a real model. Existence, creation date, param counts, Ollama tags, WebLLM IDs and ONNX repos were checked for all of them against the HF API, ollama.com tag pages and web-llm config.ts. GGUF sizes were spot-checked for 13 models and all matched exactly. No hallucinated models were found. Meta Muse Glimmer 30B (2026-08-10) is real but belongs in the next tier.

What changed:
- Ling Q4 now uses the official GGUF size.
- Unverifiable benchmark and speed claims were removed from the notes.
- Ternary Bonsai 8B was added as a notable 2026 model that brings 8B quality into about 3GB. It uses q8_gb=0 because no Q8 exists, and the app should treat 0 as N/A.

Also worth watching in trending, but left out for this tier:
- Prism ML Bonsai 1.7B/4B ternary models (niche).
- Qwen3.8 and Bonsai-2 27B models, which belong to the larger tier.

Field conventions:
- q4_gb, q8_gb and fp16_gb are GGUF text weights only. Multimodal models add mmproj: about 0.9GB for Qwen3.5/Ornith and about 1GB for Gemma 4.
- min_runtime_mem_gb = Q4 file + KV cache at 4K context + 0.3-0.5GB.
